items.text: Archie is on screen.
Dog walker is on screen.
No one is on screen except: Archie, Dog walker.
Exactly one adult man (Archie) stands at the door, matching the sprite master's face, hair, beard and clothes.
An elderly woman in a plum-coloured coat is visible in the foreground.
A small white-and-brown dog is with the elderly woman, walking beside her or on a lead.
No one other than Archie, the elderly woman and the dog is visible. There is no second man or figure at the door.
Archie stands directly in front of the green door, not beside it or in the road.
Both of Archie's hands are in his pockets.
Archie's head is turned to look along or down the street, away from the door.
Archie looks tense or wary, not relaxed, smiling or facing the viewer.
The elderly woman and dog are moving left to right across the image.
The door is green and the scene is at night. The pavement is wet, with visible reflections or sheen.
The elderly woman and dog are on the pavement in the foreground, in front of Archie and closer to the viewer.
The street, buildings and door otherwise match james_exterior.png in layout, scale and lighting, with no new elements besides Archie, the woman and the dog.
James is not visible anywhere, including in a doorway or window.
The inside of the unit is not visible. The door is closed, with no open gap or interior light spilling out to show the room.
No legible text or logos anywhere in the image.
No player face is shown (the player is never seen).
Nothing story-critical sits in the bottom ~10% of the image.
The focal point survives the small-phone crop.
